outcome: Sonographic appearance of the external anal sphincter (EAS)
cohort: 76 primiparous women after a term singleton delivery
finding: There was only minor improvement in the sonographic appearance of the EAS between 4.7 months and 26.4 months postpartum, suggesting minimal structural recovery during this period.
mod_finding: A significant EAS defect on transperineal ultrasound imaging was found in 23% of women after vaginal delivery at 4.7 months and in 21% at 26.4 months.
